dialect: Peninsular (Spain) Spanish, inferred from excluded camarero

profile.grammar_notes: Two copulas: ser (identity) and estar (location, temporary state); hay for existence. Subject pronouns usually dropped; tú/usted politeness split, vosotros for plural informal (Spain). Negation with no before the verb. Questions by intonation and inverted marks. Polite ordering in Spain: ¿me pone…?, para mí…, quería/quisiera, ¿me trae…?. Gustar-type verbs (me gusta). Closed sets: articles, subject pronouns, courses of a set meal (de primero, de segundo, de postre).
